codexGuidance.purpose: Use as a visual/style reference for an existing frontend; do not recreate this documentation board literally.
important: Element x/y positions describe the design-spec documentation board, not the target product page layout.
Apply typography, color, border, and font-family values semantically to the existing UI rather than copying absolute coordinates.

The large full-artboard fill #001922 is the background of this specification board; do not assume it must replace the application background unless the current product context supports that interpretation.
Labels such as 常规体/中黑体/中粗体 are present, but the embedded font metadata does not encode distinct weights for those three samples; do not invent weight values from the labels alone.
Microsoft YaHei appears both as "Microsoft YaHei" and "MicrosoftYaHei" in source metadata; treat them as the same family when mapping CSS fallbacks.
